lines: A short time before Kuro had nearly been killed by the security drone―――
All the key players had finally assembled for the meeting.
Siren
「Let's start the meeting at once.」
The one who kicked things off was the cyborg warrior Siren, who claimed to represent Secret Service Agency G from the UFS.
Secret Service Agency G was an organization under the umbrella of the State Department, which developed and possessed numerous powerful cyborgs.
Major, Hestia and Cyborg Asagi had once been among those.
One of their major characteristics was actively trying to utilize technology from both the Demon World and criminal underworld.
And in that regard, they were at odds with the Department of Defense-backed DSO, which was aiming to seal away Hellish technology.
Although Siren had a sleek, female-type body, her face was hidden by a cover, and it was uncertain if she even had an expression underneath it.
Her body, which gave off a dark lustre, and on which no flesh-and-blood parts could be seen at all, gave the impression of an inhuman combat machine.
Phantom Witch
「I trust this will be a worthwhile use of our time.」
The one who replied with that was the high-ranking official representing the succubi. Alias, the “Phantom Witch”.
No matter how one looked at her, she was a flesh-and-blood woman, yet at this meeting of equally powerful figures, she was exuding an unearthliness and allure that overwhelmed her surroundings.
This was only rumour, but it was said that this woman was one of the influential nobles who ruled Hell, and, to some degree, had a hand in the recent surge in demonic activity.
She was one of the most important figures in the Demon World, in other words.
Juubei
「Incredible.」
Juubei muttered, like he was overwhelmed.
Faced with the “Phantom Witch”, it was like even he couldn't make his usual flippant remarks.
Kaworu
「Fufu.」
Seeing Juubei like that, Kaworu laughed a little.
Kaworu
「I'll introduce you. He is the boss of Senzaki, the self-proclaimed “Gangster”, Kanzaki Juubei.」
They knew her true identity as well.
The leader of Amidahara Prison.
Tekkain Kaworu, who led the Tekkain clan, a faction of Fuuma ninja.
Juubei
「Come on, Boss. Despite what you might think, I've made a bit of a name for myself.」
Juubei shrugged, like he had finally gotten back into the swing of things thanks to her support.
The boss of Senzaki, an emerging city in the underworld.
Kanzaki Juubei, who led the Kanzaki clan, a faction of Fuuma ninja—That was him.
Yuri
（He's the boss of Senzaki? In other words, he's got a leader-like standing among the underworld powers running rampant in Senzaki...... He doesn't seem like that at all, though.）
Yuri muttered to herself in her mind.
Right now, she was nothing more than Juubei's guard.
The name of the assassin, the 『Snow Enchantress』 was fairly well-known.
There was no need to draw attention to herself by speaking out unnecessarily.
Siren
「Being a rising power, us supporting you will be of mutual benefit. That's what we believe.」
Siren
「Well, please take your seats.」
Secret Service Agency G, the succubi, Amidahara Prison, and Senzaki.
A meeting between four underworld powers. Negotiations about their alliance had begun.
